أتصاعب (form VI)
# أَتَصَاعَبُ (ʔataṣāʕabu) /ʔa.ta.sˤaː.ʕa.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَصَاعَبَ (taṣāʕaba)
# أَتَصَاعَبَ (ʔataṣāʕaba) /ʔa.ta.sˤaː.ʕa.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَصَاعَبَ (taṣāʕaba)
# أَتَصَاعَبْ (ʔataṣāʕab) /ʔa.ta.sˤaː.ʕab/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَصَاعَبَ (taṣāʕaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
